I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread to confirm the correction: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. Her original Dock 23 message in #central-team hasn't been edited and still shows the old value. She said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else.

One correction to my reply: I told her I'd "updated my note," but I haven't saved this to any notes page or file. Her correction is only recorded in the channel thread.
